name: MM-SafetyBench
description: MM-SafetyBench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the safety of multimodal large language models against image-based manipulations that can compromise model behavior. It includes 13 scenarios with 5,040 text-image pairs to test vulnerabilities and proposes prompting strategies to improve model resilience.
reputation: A commonly cited benchmark for multimodal safety research, especially for testing image-based jailbreaks and manipulations in MLLMs.
notes: Focuses on safety evaluation of multimodal LLMs against image-based attacks; dataset includes 13 scenarios and 5,040 text-image pairs.
